reviewer.relationship: Independent semantic review of the specialist and resumed caller artifacts; reviewer did not produce the native allocation or caller report.

scope: Combined source-level semantic review of the completed specialist allocation and retained resumed caller result, with comparison to the external runner baseline. This is a development-assistant/source review, not human, artistic, engine or native-provenance acceptance.

observed_findings.observation: The inspected modules establish shortcutEntry -> startShortcut -> statusCell("idle") -> statusVisuals.idle -> assets/start.svg. The allocation retains queue.start and attaches both consumers instead of creating duplicate art. The added reuse requirement is explicitly an observation; no new style or production requirement was invented.

started/ok/error correctly map through stateAfter to running/succeeded/failed and Working/Ready/Retry. statusCell and compactStatus share statusVisuals. idle is declared and explicitly selected by startShortcut; stateAfter does not return it. The reports further call idle initial, which the inspected source does not establish.

The final allocation retains all original source bindings, prior requirements and unrelated rows, including their production/evidence. It preserves the stale view binding and adds only coverage, two new source bindings, two Start consumers and one observation-authority reuse entry. Retained historical PLAR bytes exactly match the original baseline. The final preservation report lists only plar.txt as changed.

The caller correctly distinguishes the new source declarations from retained view drift and explains why conservative impact includes all four roles without ordering regeneration. Its parent source captures contain both complete added modules. The original specialist coverage, source map, result and final document are unchanged in the final capture.

The caller explicitly reports that it did not capture pre-save focused reads, and bases its own preservation reasoning on document/source-binding comparison. Separately, the external runner baseline and retained parent-focused reports provide exact pre/post hashes: Start changes and Working/Ready/Retry remain identical. This external comparison is not attributed to the native caller.

The accountBadge lookup source is inspected while unavailable remote registry contents remain excluded/unresolved. The renderer is present but not_inspected; no symbols, consumers, contents or runtime behavior are inferred. Metadata/hash observations are distinguished from inspection.

Missing PNG rows use inspection=inspected but each limitation explicitly restricts that label to consumer-source inspection and states that no image bytes exist. Neither specialist nor caller claims image inspection, rendering, animation playback, artistic quality or target-engine acceptance.

The original continuation record retains returncode 1 and timeout; the resumed record reports returncode 0 in native_same_session mode with the same session ID. Both records retain behavioral_verdict ungraded. These are retained recorder observations, not an independent native-completion or provenance verdict from this review.

caveats.finding: Both narratives call idle the initial QueueState. The inspected source declares the union and explicit shortcut input but shows no initialization.
caveats.accurate_statement: idle is a declared QueueState selected explicitly by startShortcut and is not produced by stateAfter.
caveats.disposition: Preserve the native wording as evidence and qualify future summaries. It does not change the correct asset allocation or state/function mapping.

caveats.finding: The native caller did not capture focused reads before save and acknowledges this in CALLER-RESULT.json:79. Its document-comparison argument and the external runner pre/post identity proof are distinct evidence.
caveats.disposition: Do not describe the native caller as having captured pre/post focused hash pairs.

caveats.finding: The missing-image rows use inspection=inspected for the consumer source, while their explicit limitations state that no image bytes exist.
caveats.disposition: Do not count those rows as image or visual inspection; retain the source-only interpretation.

limits: This receipt reviews retained source text, semantic interpretations and artifact comparisons. It does not replay the native trials or independently audit every native tool event.

Mechanical grading, tool-result provenance, named-role activation and same-parent continuation qualification remain the responsibility of their separate receipts. This review does not replace or override preserved failed grades.
The external runner baseline comparison is separate from the native caller evidence and from visual acceptance.
No renderer contents, unavailable remote registry contents, image rendering, artistic judgment, target-engine integration or human acceptance were inspected or performed.
Native statements of no execution refer to the native allocation work; fixture preparation has a separate descriptor-reachability observation.
The original timeout remains evidence of a bounded first-process failure. A retained resumed report does not establish broad host reliability or M1/M2 acceptance.
